description: [immutable] URL이 콘텐츠 변경 시 새로 발급되는(재사용되지 않는) 자산
expression: (http.host eq "blog.plzhans.com") and (http.request.uri.path wildcard "*_hu_*.webp" or http.request.uri.path wildcard "*_hu_*.avif" or http.request.uri.path wildcard "*_hu_*.png" or http.request.uri.path wildcard "*_hu_*.jpg" or http.request.uri.path wildcard "*_hu_*.jpeg" or http.request.uri.path wildcard "*_hu_*.gif" or http.request.uri.path wildcard "*_hu_*.bmp" or http.request.uri.path wildcard "*_hu_*.tif" or http.request.uri.path wildcard "*_hu_*.tiff" or http.request.uri.path wildcard "/css/main.min.*.css")
